'''Noth Armin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He was killed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] around [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="TOR" />
